data.heading: Education
data.description:
My academic journey has involved many late nights, lots of coffee, and a growing curiosity about how coffee is grown, roasted, brewed, and enjoyed. 

Over time, I have learned that research is mostly a process of trial and error. Every experiment that does not go as planned is a good excuse to make another cup of coffee, think through a new idea, and try again. 

I certainly do not have all the answers yet, but I have learned that making mistakes is part of learning. As long as there is good coffee nearby, every challenge feels a little easier to overcome.
